data.text: [00:04]Hey, Jerry, I’m making some coffee... `[00:07.5]would you like some?
[00:10.9]Coffee? … Would you like some coffee?
[00:17]What are you reading that’s so interesting … ?
[00:20]It’s an article about Valentino Rossi. `[00:23.5]You know – the motorbike racer. `[00:25]It’s fascinating!
[00:28.4]That’s right – and he’s very successful – one of the best motorbike racers ever.
[00:33.7]Is he the world champion, then?
[00:36]He’s actually won nine world championships. `[00:39.5]It says here that he’s won nearly half of all his races in his career …
